findings.title: Institution tenant lacks an owner admin
findings.evidence: tenant-northstar-university has no owner admin role.
findings.action: Assign an accountable owner admin before enabling enterprise controls.

findings.title: Admin account does not enforce MFA
findings.action: Require MFA for all enterprise admins before exposing organization-wide controls.

findings.title: Least-privilege role review is missing
findings.evidence: tenant-northstar-university has no recorded role-policy review.
findings.action: Schedule periodic role reviews for admins, lab leads, reviewers, and export operators.

findings.title: Institution admin dashboard is missing a required widget
findings.action: Enable the required admin dashboard widget before enterprise rollout.

findings.title: Institution admin dashboard is missing a required widget
findings.action: Enable the required admin dashboard widget before enterprise rollout.

findings.title: Institution admin dashboard is missing a required widget
findings.action: Enable the required admin dashboard widget before enterprise rollout.

findings.title: Admin dashboard data freshness exceeds target
findings.action: Refresh usage, compliance, and project metrics at least hourly for enterprise reporting.

findings.title: Enterprise API lacks required project read scope
findings.action: Add least-privilege project read scope for institutional reporting integrations.

findings.title: Enterprise API keys lack rotation policy
findings.evidence: tenant-northstar-university has no API key rotation interval.
findings.action: Set an API key rotation interval and notify integration owners before expiry.

findings.title: Webhook lacks signature verification
findings.evidence: https://repo.example.edu/hooks/scibase has no signing secret configured.
findings.action: Configure signed webhooks before sending project, publication, or compliance events.

findings.title: Webhook lacks retry policy
findings.evidence: https://repo.example.edu/hooks/scibase has no retry attempts configured.
findings.action: Add retry/backoff so institutional systems do not miss critical events.

findings.title: Export pipeline destination or format is incomplete
findings.action: Configure destination and format before one-click institutional exports are enabled.

findings.title: Export pipeline requires PII scrub but it is disabled
findings.evidence: pubmed-export requires PII scrub for PubMed Central.
findings.action: Enable PII scrub and add an export reviewer before routing data to external systems.

findings.title: Export pipeline does not have a passing dry run
findings.action: Run a dry export and resolve validation errors before enabling production exports.

findings.title: Enterprise audit logging is disabled
findings.evidence: tenant-northstar-university lacks audit logging for admin and export actions.
findings.action: Enable immutable audit logs before enterprise admin tooling is activated.

findings.title: Funder mandate tracking is disabled
findings.evidence: tenant-northstar-university cannot surface open access or reproducibility mandate compliance.
findings.action: Enable funder mandate tracking for compliance dashboard coverage.

findings.title: Enterprise SLA profile is incomplete
findings.action: Attach the contracted SLA tier and response window to the tenant profile.

findings.title: Data-processing agreement is required but missing
findings.evidence: tenant-northstar-university contract requires DPA with no agreement ID.
findings.action: Collect the DPA before enabling cross-system data export or analytics.
